overloads.semanticRole: The SORT ARRAY command sorts one or more arrays into ascending or descending order.

constraints: The order symbol is counterintuitive: > sorts ascending, < sorts descending; if omitted, the sort is ascending.
Pointer and Picture arrays cannot be sorted.
For a two-dimensional array, only an element (e.g. a2DArray{i}) can be sorted, not the two-dimensional array itself.

When multiple arrays are passed, they are all reordered together following the sort order computed from the first array only; this is a single-level sort, not a multi-level sort (use MULTI SORT ARRAY for synchronized multi-level sorting).
